notes: Modified cash basis village. Governmental lines from Exhibit III Total Governmental Funds column (pp6-7); spending is listed by object only, so General/Street mixed lines are general government with review (Rock and Gravel is Street Fund only). Business-type lines from Exhibit IV Total Proprietary Funds (p8). Fund balances (modified cash basis fund balance) are in *_fund_balance; ending_cash = governmental Total Assets (cash and deposits + county treasurer) p7; beginning cash is not printed. Balance sheet: governmental lines from the governmental funds statement (totals equal the government-wide figures), business-type from the proprietary statement; totals from the Statement of Net Position p1. Detail: General Fund combining schedules (General, Community Center, RV Park columns, pp9-10), Street Fund budgetary comparison (p11), proprietary budgetary comparison (Electric, Water, p12). The trim lacks the combining-schedule pages with the Parks & Recreation Fund column (its receipts 1,772.82 and disbursements 20,543.35 appear only in the unaudited combined statement p13) and the proprietary budget page with the Sewer Fund column; Sewer Fund detail is taken from the Exhibit IV Sewer Fund column (p8), whose Electric/Water columns equal the budget schedule's. Proprietary budget column is the combined total and General Fund sub-fund budgets are printed only as totals, so per-fund budget_final is null there. No transfers in the actual columns (proprietary budget column only). The unaudited combined statement p13 was not recorded. Read pages 1-13 of 13
